name: Data Science & ML
headline: Predict what happens next, then act on it.
intro: Machine learning models that forecast demand, flag risk and recognise patterns in your data, built, validated and deployed as part of the software you already use.

overview.what: Data science and machine learning turns historical and live data into predictive models: forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, recommendation and computer vision, taken from experiment to production service.
overview.why: Many decisions, such as how much stock to hold, which customers might leave or which transaction looks suspicious, are made on instinct. A validated model brings consistent, data-driven predictions to those decisions.
problems: Forecasts built on averages that miss seasonality and trends
Churn, defaults or faults noticed only after the damage is done
Data scattered across systems and too inconsistent to learn from
Experimental models that never reach production or silently degrade
overview.approach: We frame the business question first, assess data readiness honestly, build a simple baseline before anything complex, validate against held-out data, and deploy with monitoring so the model remains reliable.

deliver.d: Demand, sales, price, churn and risk predictions tailored to your data.
Models that sort, score and flag unusual events such as fraud or equipment faults.
Personalised product, content or next-best-action suggestions.
Image inspection, document understanding, text classification and sentiment analysis.
Reliable, repeatable preparation of the data your models learn from.
APIs and batch jobs with drift detection, retraining and performance tracking.

capabilities.d: Trend, seasonality and event effects modelled for planning and replenishment.
Gradient boosting, random forests and neural networks for classification and regression.
Clustering and segmentation that reveal customer groups and behaviour patterns.
Feature importance and plain-language reasons so stakeholders can trust predictions.
Cross-validation, back-testing and business-metric evaluation before release.
Versioned data and models, reproducible training and automated deployment.

process.d: We translate a business goal into a measurable prediction task and success metric.
Sources, quality, volume and gaps are reviewed, with a realistic view of what is achievable.
A simple benchmark is set, then richer features and models are tested against it.
Results are checked on unseen data and reviewed with domain experts.
The model is delivered as an API, dashboard feed or scheduled job in your environment.
Drift and accuracy are tracked, and models are refreshed as data changes.

benefits.d: Forecasts reduce overstocking, shortages and idle capacity.
Risk and anomaly detection surface issues while they can still be fixed.
Model-supported decisions are repeatable and measurable.
Relevant recommendations for every customer without manual effort.
Your data becomes a durable asset instead of an archive.

usecases.d: Store and SKU-level predictions guide purchasing and stock levels.
Subscribers at risk are identified early so retention teams can act.
Vision models detect defects on a production line.
Transactions and applications are scored and routed for review.

cta.h: Find out what your data can already tell you.
cta.p: Share the decision you want to improve and the data you hold. We will assess feasibility and propose a focused first model.
